summary: Security-focused software engineer with 2+ years of professional experience applying cybersecurity principles throughout the software development lifecycle in production environments. Hands-on experience implementing security controls across production systems: automated vulnerability scanning via SonarCloud SAST in every CI/CD pipeline, OAuth2 and JWT authentication with RS256 signing, OWASP compliant API design with input validation at every trust boundary, least-privilege IAM across AWS, and encryption in transit and at rest. bullets.text: Implemented security controls and cybersecurity best practices throughout the secure software development lifecycle on all production systems. Applied OWASP compliant API design, input validation at every trust boundary, authentication and authorisation controls, encryption in transit and at rest, and security quality gates in every CI/CD pipeline. Security embedded in design and development rather than applied as a post-delivery audit.

Conducted automated vulnerability assessments and security scanning across production codebases. SonarCloud SAST integrated into every GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline detecting OWASP vulnerability patterns, SQL injection risks, insecure dependency versions, and security anti-patterns before production deployment. Participated in remediation activities to address identified vulnerabilities and prevent recurrence.

Designed and implemented OAuth2 and JWT authentication systems for production APIs. Applied RS256 signing for tamper-evident token validation, enforced token expiry and audience claim validation on every request, implemented RBAC with least-privilege access control, and applied Spring Security for defence-in-depth authentication architecture.

Applied least-privilege access control and IAM security principles across all AWS cloud resources. Designed fine-grained IAM policies restricting service permissions to minimum required access, implemented resource-based policies, enforced encryption of data at rest using AWS KMS compatible patterns, and audited IAM configurations for privilege escalation risks as standard practice.

Maintained security compliance and documentation throughout all project delivery. Produced technical documentation for security controls, authentication architecture, and API security specifications. Supported security review activities and contributed to security-aware engineering standards across cross-functional teams.

Participated in incident response and root cause analysis for production security-related events. Applied structured investigation methodology across distributed system boundaries, drove permanent fixes to address underlying vulnerabilities rather than symptomatic patches, and maintained 24/7 on-call production ownership with blameless postmortems.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams including security, QA, DevOps, and architecture stakeholders to deliver secure solutions meeting both technical and compliance requirements. Communicated security risks, trade-offs, and remediation approaches clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Leveraged AI-assisted development tools including Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to improve security engineering productivity, accelerate security review processes, and maintain high code quality standards throughout all professional work.

Conducted structured security and performance assessments for enterprise Java applications, identifying vulnerabilities and performance risks through systematic analysis. Contributed to a 30% improvement in system reliability through root cause investigation and remediation.
Collaborated with senior engineers and stakeholders, producing clear technical documentation and communicating findings effectively across technical and non-technical audiences.
